ex: 他在城里做买卖。
He does business in town.
这笔买卖赚了不少钱。
This deal made quite a lot of money.
use: Read mǎimai; 做买卖 "run a business", close to 做生意.

ex: 学校要选拔十名学生参加比赛。
The school will pick ten students for the competition.
国家队正在选拔新队员。
The national team is selecting new players.
use: For picking talent; 选 is plainer.

ex: 这个国家的武装力量很强。
This country's armed forces are strong.
武装力量包括陆军、海军和空军。
The armed forces include the army, navy and air force.
这件事引起了舆论的关注。
This affair drew public attention.
政府很重视社会舆论。
The government pays close attention to public opinion.
use: 舆论压力 "pressure of public opinion".

ex: 这次火灾是人为的。
This fire was started by people.
很多环境问题都是人为造成的。
Many environmental problems are man-made.
use: 人为因素 "human factor"; opposite 自然.

ex: 请重复一遍。
Please repeat that.
这两个句子的意思重复了。
These two sentences say the same thing.
我们一起欣赏音乐吧。
Let's enjoy some music together.
老板很欣赏他的工作能力。
The boss really admires his ability.
use: For art and scenery, and for admiring people.

ex: 我想找一个律师。
I want to find a lawyer.
他的律师在法庭上说得很好。
His lawyer spoke very well in court.
use: Measure word 位 or 名.

m: Sound the **bugle** and **summon**: to **call on**, appeal.
ex: 学校号召大家节约用水。
The school calls on everyone to save water.
很多人响应了政府的号召。
Many people answered the government's call.
use: 号召某人做某事 "call on someone to do something".

ex: 元朝设立了行省。
The Yuan dynasty set up provinces.
行省制度对后来的中国影响很大。
The province system greatly influenced later China.
你的名字在名单上。
Your name is on the list.
老师把参加比赛的名单贴在墙上。
The teacher posted the list of contestants on the wall.
这个词的定义是什么？
What's the definition of this word?
很难给幸福下一个定义。
It's hard to define happiness.
我收到了你的信。
I got your letter.
收到消息以后，请马上回复。
Please reply as soon as you get the message.
use: 收到! also means "Got it!" in chats.

ex: 她在公司负责财务。
She handles finance at the company.
这家公司的财务情况很好。
This company's finances are in good shape.
我一辈子都不会忘记你。
I'll never forget you as long as I live.
他在这个村子里住了一辈子。
He lived in this village his whole life.
天气对比赛不利。
The weather is bad for the match.
吸烟对身体健康不利。
Smoking is bad for your health.
use: Pattern 对…不利; opposite 有利.

ex: 这里的自然景观非常美。
The natural landscape here is very beautiful.
城市里新建了很多景观。
Many new landscaped sights have been built in the city.
他们发表了一份宣言。
They issued a declaration.
《共产党宣言》是马克思和恩格斯写的。
The Communist Manifesto was written by Marx and Engels.
莫斯科的冬天非常冷。
Winters in Moscow are very cold.
他坐火车从北京到了莫斯科。
He took the train from Beijing to Moscow.
她是北京大学的研究生。
She's a graduate student at Peking University.
大学毕业以后，他想读研究生。
After graduating, he wants to do a master's.
use: 读研究生 "do postgraduate study"; 考研 is the exam.

m: A **special** **zone** for the **economy**: a **special economic zone**.
ex: 深圳是中国第一个经济特区。
Shenzhen was China's first special economic zone.
经济特区的发展速度非常快。
Special economic zones developed extremely fast.
use: Set up from 1980; shortened to 特区.

ex: 这条河是两国的边界。
This river is the border between the two countries.
两国正在讨论边界问题。
The two countries are discussing border issues.
use: For lines between countries or areas.

ex: 服务业在经济中的比重越来越大。
The service sector makes up a growing share of the economy.
女性在公司员工中占的比重很高。
Women make up a large share of the company's staff.
互联网改变了我们的生活。
The Internet has changed our lives.
现在很多人通过互联网学习汉语。
Many people now learn Chinese on the Internet.
use: In speech 网 or 网上.

ex: 人民公社出现在一九五八年。
People's communes appeared in 1958.
爷爷年轻时在人民公社劳动。
When Grandpa was young, he worked in a people's commune.
他在军队的政治部工作。
He works in the army's political department.
政治部负责部队的思想教育。
The political department is in charge of the troops' ideological education.
他是这家公司的总裁。
He's the president of this company.
总裁明天要去国外开会。
The CEO is going abroad for a meeting tomorrow.
use: Close to 总经理; 总裁 is usually higher.

ex: 学生是一个很特别的群体。
Students are a special group.
这个活动是为老年人群体举办的。
This event is held for the elderly.
use: For groups of people with something in common.

m: The **ground** of the battle **line**: a **position**, front.
ex: 士兵们守住了阵地。
The soldiers held their position.
学校是教育的主要阵地。
Schools are the front line of education.
房子内外都很干净。
The house is clean inside and out.
这件事在国内外引起了很大反响。
This caused a big response at home and abroad.
use: After a number it can mean "about": 一个月内外.

ex: 这个国家打了十年内战。
This country fought a civil war for ten years.
内战让很多人失去了家。
The civil war left many people homeless.
今天的训练强度很大。
Today's training was very intense.
这种材料的强度很高。
This material is very strong.
这个博物馆免费参观。
This museum is free to visit.
买一个大的，送一个免费的小杯子。
Buy a large one and get a small cup free.
use: Opposite 收费; 免费 is for price, not "freedom" (自由).

ex: 请启动电脑。
Please start the computer.
这个项目下个月正式启动。
This project officially launches next month.
住酒店要先登记。
You have to check in first to stay at a hotel.
他们上个月登记结婚了。
They registered their marriage last month.
长颈鹿的脖子很长。
A giraffe's neck is very long.
天冷了，围上围巾，别让脖子着凉。
It's cold; put on a scarf so your neck doesn't catch cold.
我弟弟今年十三岁。
My younger brother is thirteen.
这本书一共有十三课。
This book has thirteen lessons.
use: 十三 also forms 十三亿 "1.3 billion".

ex: 司令部设在山下。
The headquarters was set up below the mountain.
命令从司令部传了下来。
The order came down from headquarters.
他是一名美术老师。
He's an art teacher.
她从小就喜欢美术，特别是画画。
She has loved art since childhood, especially drawing.

m: **Filial piety** **moves** heaven, **city**: **Xiaogan**, a city in Hubei.
ex: 孝感市在武汉的北边。
Xiaogan is north of Wuhan.
孝感市有很多关于孝的故事。
Xiaogan has many stories about filial piety.
use: Named after the legend of the devoted son Dong Yong.

ex: 听到哨声，大家立时停了下来。
At the whistle, everyone stopped at once.
吃了药，他立时觉得好多了。
After taking the medicine, he felt much better right away.
这次比赛奠定了他的地位。
This competition established his position.
小时候的学习为他以后的成功奠定了基础。
His childhood studies laid the foundation for his later success.
明天考试，我要复习一下。
There's an exam tomorrow; I need to revise.
老师让我们每天复习学过的生词。
The teacher has us review new words every day.
他是一位富家公子。
He's the son of a rich family.
小说里的公子长得很英俊。
The young master in the novel is very handsome.
这里的地形很复杂。
The terrain here is complex.
这个地区的地形以山地为主。
This area is mostly mountainous terrain.
两个队在场上激烈对抗。
The two teams clashed fiercely on the field.
他一个人没有办法对抗整个公司。
He can't stand up to the whole company alone.
use: Close to 抵抗, but often two equal sides.

ex: 这位老人的剪纸技艺很高。
This old man's paper-cutting skill is superb.
这门技艺已经传了三百年。
This craft has been handed down for three hundred years.

m: Set up **standing** like a **tree**: to **establish**, set up.
ex: 他为我们树立了好榜样。
He set a good example for us.
我们要树立正确的观念。
We should form the right ideas.
use: With 榜样, 信心, 形象.

ex: 黄冈市在湖北省东部。
Huanggang is in eastern Hubei.
黄冈市的中学很有名。
Huanggang's high schools are well known.

m: A **horizontal board** over the **forehead** of a door: an **inscribed board**.
ex: 大门上挂着一块匾额。
An inscribed board hangs over the gate.
这块匾额上的字是皇帝写的。
The writing on this board is by the emperor.
最近来这里的游客增多了。
More tourists have been coming here recently.
一到冬天，感冒的人就增多了。
As soon as winter comes, more people catch colds.
use: For numbers of things; 增加 is broader.

ex: 他学习很自觉。
He studies without being told.
大家都应该自觉遵守规定。
Everyone should follow the rules of their own accord.
use: Often "do something without being made to".

m: **Pass on** and **increase**: to **increase step by step**.
ex: 学生人数每年递增。
Student numbers rise every year.
工资会随着工作年限递增。
Pay rises step by step with years of service.
我不想伤害你。
I don't want to hurt you.
喝太多酒会伤害身体。
Drinking too much harms your body.
use: Body or feelings; 受伤 is "get hurt".

ex: 他因为杀人被判了刑。
He was sentenced for murder.
这部电影讲的是一个杀人案。
This film is about a murder case.
汉字是从图画演变来的。
Chinese characters evolved from pictures.
这个小问题慢慢演变成了大问题。
This small problem slowly turned into a big one.
指挥部设在一个小村子里。
The command post was set up in a small village.
抗洪指挥部的人一夜没睡。
The flood-control headquarters staff didn't sleep all night.
屋子里很暖和。
It's warm in the room.
他把屋子收拾得干干净净。
He tidied the room until it was spotless.
use: Northern spoken; 房间 is standard.

ex: 这里是皇家花园。
This is a royal garden.
皇家的生活非常豪华。
Royal life is very luxurious.
use: Before nouns: 皇家公园, 皇家学院.

ex: 民众对这项政策很满意。
The public is pleased with this policy.
很多民众来到广场参加活动。
Many people came to the square for the event.
港口里停着很多船舶。
Many ships are moored in the harbour.
这家工厂专门生产船舶。
This factory specialises in building ships.
use: Formal and collective; 船 is everyday.

ex: 这乃是我们的责任。
This is indeed our responsibility.
诚实乃是做人的根本。
Honesty is the foundation of being a good person.
use: Literary for 是 or 就是.

ex: 中国代表团到达了北京。
The Chinese delegation arrived in Beijing.
代表团在这里参观了三天。
The delegation visited here for three days.
这是正常的生理现象。
This is a normal physical response.
青春期孩子的生理变化很大。
Teenagers go through big physical changes.
请查看你的邮件。
Please check your email.
医生仔细查看了他的伤口。
The doctor carefully examined his wound.
use: Common in apps: 查看详情 "view details".

ex: 政府加大了打击力度。
The government stepped up its crackdown.
这个钢琴家弹琴很有力度。
This pianist plays with great force.
他的鼻子很高。
He has a high nose.
我感冒了，鼻子不通气。
I have a cold and my nose is blocked.
这里出土了很多古代文物。
Many ancient relics were dug up here.
这把剑是两千年前的，去年才出土。
This sword is two thousand years old and was only unearthed last year.
他在国外三年，其间只回过一次家。
He spent three years abroad and came home only once in that time.
他们讨论了两个小时，其间没有人休息。
They talked for two hours, and nobody took a break in between.
吸烟危害健康。
Smoking is harmful to health.
这种虫子对庄稼危害很大。
This insect does great harm to crops.
use: Stronger than 伤害; often for health and society.

ex: 这条河的上游有很多山。
There are many mountains on the upper reaches of this river.
他的成绩一直在班里的上游。
His grades have always been near the top of the class.
列车马上就要开了。
The train is about to leave.
这趟列车从北京开往上海。
This train runs from Beijing to Shanghai.
use: Formal; 火车 is everyday. Measure word 趟 or 列.

m: **Cut off** **at** a date: **up to**, by (a time).
ex: 截至昨天，报名人数已经超过一千。
By yesterday, over a thousand people had registered.
截至目前，还没有人受伤。
So far, nobody has been hurt.
这部电影基于一个真实的故事。
This film is based on a true story.
基于以上原因，我们决定取消活动。
For the above reasons, we've decided to cancel the event.
use: Formal; at the start or after the verb.

ex: 眼前呈现出一片美丽的风景。
A beautiful view opened up before our eyes.
这座城市呈现出新的面貌。
The city has taken on a new look.
你过于担心了。
You're worrying too much.
这个计划过于复杂，很难实行。
This plan is too complicated to carry out.

m: **Lead** the way **first**: to **be in the lead**.
ex: 我们队领先两分。
Our team is leading by two points.
这家公司的技术在世界上领先。
This company's technology leads the world.
use: 处于领先地位 "be in the lead".

ex: 现在是买房的好时机。
Now is a good time to buy a home.
他抓住了时机，一下子成功了。
He seized the moment and succeeded at once.
use: 时机成熟 "the time is ripe".

ex: 他是一名足球球员。
He's a football player.
这位球员受伤了，不能参加比赛。
This player is injured and can't play.
军民一起抗洪救灾。
Soldiers and civilians fought the floods together.
这里的军民关系非常好。
Relations between the army and local people are very good here.
use: Political term: 军民一家 "army and people are one family".

ex: 我还记得当时的情景。
I still remember the scene at that time.
看到孩子们开心的情景，我也很高兴。
Seeing the children so happy made me happy too.
use: Close to 情形 and 场面.

m: The **ministry** of **works**: the **Ministry of Works** in imperial China.
ex: 工部负责修建宫殿和道路。
The Ministry of Works was in charge of building palaces and roads.
他在工部当了很多年的官。
He was an official in the Ministry of Works for many years.
use: One of the six ministries; historical.

ex: 科学家测定了这块石头的年代。
Scientists determined the age of this rock.
我们要先测定水的温度。
We need to measure the water temperature first.
天上有一个奇怪的物体。
There's a strange object in the sky.
物体从高处落下来速度会越来越快。
An object falling from a height speeds up.
use: Physics word; 东西 is everyday.

ex: 这里有很多野生动物。
There are many wild animals here.
野生的蘑菇有的有毒，不能随便吃。
Some wild mushrooms are poisonous; don't just eat them.
路上发生了交通事故。
There was a traffic accident on the road.
这次事故没有人受伤。
No one was hurt in the accident.
use: Measure word 起 or 次.

ex: 你想过后果吗？
Have you thought about the consequences?
不注意安全会造成严重的后果。
Being careless about safety can have serious consequences.
今天气温高于三十度。
It's above thirty degrees today.
这里的房价远远高于其他城市。
House prices here are far higher than in other cities.
这个国家的法律很健全。
This country's legal system is sound.
我们要健全管理制度。
We need to improve the management system.
use: Also of body and mind: 身心健全.

m: A big **group** of **soldiers**: a **corps**, large military unit.
ex: 他父母年轻时在新疆兵团工作。
His parents worked in the Xinjiang Production Corps when young.
几个兵团一起向前进攻。
Several corps attacked together.
use: 新疆兵团 "Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps".

ex: 这条路封闭了。
This road is closed.
这个小村子很封闭，很少有外人来。
This small village is very isolated; few outsiders come.
我家住在一条小胡同里。
My home is in a little alley.
很多游客去北京看胡同。
Many tourists go to Beijing to see the hutongs.
我们队进入了决赛。
Our team has reached the final.
今天晚上有世界杯决赛。
The World Cup final is tonight.
这里的治安很好。
Public safety here is good.
警察负责维护城市的治安。
The police keep public order in the city.
use: 治安好 / 治安差 "safe / unsafe".

ex: 计划有一点变动。
There's a small change to the plan.
最近公司的人事变动很大。
There have been big staff changes at the company recently.
犯人从监狱逃走了。
A prisoner escaped from jail.
警察把犯人带走了。
The police took the prisoner away.
我们和他们的差距很大。
There's a big gap between us and them.
城市和农村的收入差距在缩小。
The income gap between city and countryside is narrowing.
use: Read chājù; 缩小差距 "narrow the gap".

ex: 纽约是美国最大的城市。
New York is the largest city in the USA.
她在纽约读书，明年回国。
She's studying in New York and returns home next year.
紫禁城就是现在的故宫。
The Forbidden City is today's Palace Museum.
明清两代的皇帝都住在紫禁城。
Emperors of the Ming and Qing both lived in the Forbidden City.
微软是一家美国公司。
Microsoft is an American company.
我的电脑用的是微软的系统。
My computer runs a Microsoft system.
医生在他的肺里发现了一个肿瘤。
The doctor found a tumour in his lung.
这家医院专门治疗肿瘤。
This hospital specialises in treating tumours.
use: 良性 "benign" / 恶性肿瘤 "malignant tumour".

m: **Lower** the **head**: to **bow the head**, also to give in.
ex: 他低头看手机。
He looked down at his phone.
不管多难，他从来不向困难低头。
However hard it gets, he never gives in to difficulties.
use: 向…低头 "give in to…"; opposite 抬头.

ex: 故宫是世界上最大的古代建筑群。
The Forbidden City is the world's largest ancient building complex.
山上有一片古老的建筑群。
There's a cluster of old buildings on the mountain.
use: Measure word 片 or 座.

ex: 这道题的答案是什么？
What's the answer to this question?
我想了很久，还是找不到答案。
I thought for ages but still couldn't find the answer.
use: For questions and puzzles; 回答 is a reply.

ex: 我在学中文。
I'm learning Chinese.
这本书有中文翻译吗？
Is there a Chinese translation of this book?
use: Same as 汉语; 中文 leans to written Chinese.

ex: 你是几月份出生的？
Which month were you born in?
七月份和八月份是这里最热的时候。
July and August are the hottest months here.
use: Usually 几月份, 三月份.

m: **Liu** (surname) and **prepared**: **Liu Bei**, a ruler of the Three Kingdoms.
ex: 刘备是三国时期蜀国的皇帝。
Liu Bei was the emperor of Shu in the Three Kingdoms period.
刘备三次去请诸葛亮出山。
Liu Bei visited Zhuge Liang three times to ask him to serve.
use: 三顾茅庐 "three visits to the thatched cottage".

ex: 这座火山已经一百年没有喷发了。
This volcano hasn't erupted for a hundred years.
日本有很多火山。
Japan has many volcanoes.
蒙古族人很会骑马。
Mongols are very good riders.
他是蒙古族，住在内蒙古。
He's Mongolian and lives in Inner Mongolia.
这座城市有很多桥梁。
This city has many bridges.
语言是沟通的桥梁。
Language is a bridge for communication.
我们要保护消费者的权益。
We must protect consumers' rights.
工人有权维护自己的合法权益。
Workers have the right to defend their legal rights.
广场正中有一个大花坛。
There's a big flower bed in the middle of the square.
桌子放在房间的正中。
The table is in the centre of the room.
use: Also "hit right on": 正中下怀 "just what one wanted".

ex: 我在学初级汉语。
I'm studying elementary Chinese.
这本书适合初级水平的学生。
This book suits beginners.
这是官方的消息。
This is official news.
英语和法语都是加拿大的官方语言。
English and French are both official languages of Canada.
use: Before nouns: 官方网站 "official website".

ex: 我们都是好弟兄。
We're all good buddies.
他有三个弟兄，都在外地工作。
He has three brothers, all working elsewhere.
use: Spoken; 兄弟 is more common.

ex: 我提议我们休息一下。
I suggest we take a break.
大家都同意他的提议。
Everyone agreed to his proposal.
请在汤里添加一点盐。
Please add a little salt to the soup.
我添加了你的微信。
I've added you on WeChat.
use: Common in apps: 添加好友 "add friend".

ex: 这里的风光很美。
The scenery here is beautiful.
我们坐船欣赏两岸的风光。
We took a boat to enjoy the views on both banks.
他是一个讲信用的人。
He's a man who keeps his word.
你可以用信用卡付钱。
You can pay by credit card.
他抑制不住心里的高兴。
He couldn't hold back his joy.
这种药可以抑制病毒。
This medicine can inhibit the virus.
新法律从明年开始施行。
The new law comes into force next year.
医生给他施行了手术。
The doctor performed an operation on him.
第二次世界大战在一九四五年结束。
World War II ended in 1945.
我爷爷经历过第二次世界大战。
My grandfather lived through World War II.

m: The **owner** of the **land**: a **landlord**, also host.
ex: 他家以前是地主。
His family were landlords in the past.
你来北京，我做地主，请你吃饭。
When you come to Beijing, I'll be your host and treat you to dinner.
你要注意饮食。
You should watch your diet.
南方和北方的饮食习惯不同。
Eating habits differ between the north and south.
他开创了一个新时代。
He started a new era.
这位科学家开创了一个新的研究领域。
This scientist pioneered a new field of research.
use: With 时代, 事业, 局面.

ex: 中国是一个人口大国。
China is a country with a huge population.
几个大国一起开会讨论这个问题。
Several major powers met to discuss this issue.
他是三国时期有名的大将。
He was a famous general of the Three Kingdoms.
大将带着军队出发了。
The general set out with his army.
这个小镇在中国和越南的边境上。
This town is on the China–Vietnam border.
过边境的时候要检查护照。
You have your passport checked when crossing the border.
use: Area near the border; 边界 is the line itself.

m: A **boundary** and **realm**: a **state**, level of attainment.
ex: 他的画达到了很高的境界。
His painting has reached a very high level.
这是一种人生境界。
This is a state of life.
use: Mostly figurative, about spirit and art.

ex: 盐是一种晶体。
Salt is a crystal.
雪花是很漂亮的晶体。
Snowflakes are beautiful crystals.
请在这里等候。
Please wait here.
很多人在门口等候开门。
Many people are waiting at the door for it to open.
他长得很高大。
He's tall and big.
路两边有高大的树。
There are tall trees on both sides of the road.
我只是随便问问罢了。
I was just asking, that's all.
他不过是个孩子罢了，别生气。
He's only a child; don't be angry.
use: At the end, often with 只是 / 不过.

ex: 我肚子饿了。
I'm hungry.
吃了太多冰淇淋，他肚子疼。
He ate too much ice cream and has a stomach ache.
use: 肚子疼 "stomach ache"; 一肚子气 "full of anger".

ex: 他一拳把对手打倒了。
He knocked his opponent down with one punch.
小偷被警察打倒在地上。
The thief was knocked to the ground by the police.
五代时期中国很乱。
China was in chaos during the Five Dynasties.
五代以后是宋朝。
After the Five Dynasties came the Song.
use: Usually 五代十国 "Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms".

ex: 这个派出所的辖区很大。
This police station covers a large area.
市长管理整个辖区的工作。
The mayor manages the whole administrative area.
这次比赛只有三个名额。
There are only three places in this competition.
学校给了我们班两个名额。
The school gave our class two places.
这是我们的事，跟旁人没关系。
This is our business; it's nothing to do with anyone else.
旁人都看出来他很紧张。
Everyone around could see he was nervous.
我每天十一点睡觉。
I go to bed at eleven every day.
太晚了，孩子们快去睡觉吧！
It's late, children; off to bed now!
use: Separable: 睡了一个好觉 "had a good sleep".

ex: 我们商议一下明天的计划。
Let's discuss tomorrow's plan.
大家商议了很久，才做出决定。
Everyone conferred for a long time before deciding.
他每天锻炼，肌肉很发达。
He works out every day and is very muscular.
运动以后，我的腿部肌肉很疼。
After exercise, my leg muscles really ache.
这篇文章层次很清楚。
This essay is well structured.
他们俩的文化层次不一样。
The two of them have different levels of education.
use: Also "tier" of quality: 高层次人才.

ex: 各人有各人的想法。
Everyone has their own ideas.
吃完饭各人洗自己的碗。
After eating, each person washes their own bowl.
桂林在广西。
Guilin is in Guangxi.
广西的米粉很好吃。
Guangxi rice noodles are delicious.
use: Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region; short name 桂.

ex: 此处禁止停车。
No parking here.
此处风景很美，值得一看。
The scenery here is lovely and worth seeing.
use: Written, on signs; 这里 is spoken.

ex: 人民推翻了旧政府。
The people overthrew the old government.
新的证据推翻了原来的结论。
New evidence overturned the original conclusion.
他半晌没说话。
He didn't say anything for a long while.
我等了半晌，他才出来。
I waited for ages before he came out.
use: Literary or northern; close to 半天.

ex: 下周我们有一次模拟考试。
We have a mock exam next week.
这个软件可以模拟开飞机。
This software can simulate flying a plane.

m: Not by a **hair**, **not**: **not in the least**.
ex: 他毫不犹豫地答应了。
He agreed without the slightest hesitation.
她对这件事毫不关心。
She doesn't care about this at all.
use: Before two-character verbs or adjectives: 毫不在乎.

ex: 旅游业是这里的支柱产业。
Tourism is the main industry here.
父亲是我们家的支柱。
Father is the pillar of our family.
这次投资的收益很好。
This investment had good returns.
读书带来的收益是长期的。
The benefits of reading are long-term.
他不顾危险，跳进河里救人。
Ignoring the danger, he jumped into the river to save someone.
她不顾父母反对，去了国外。
She went abroad despite her parents' objections.
学校周边有很多饭馆。
There are many restaurants around the school.
这个城市和周边地区的交通很方便。
Transport between the city and surrounding areas is convenient.
我喜欢吃煮玉米。
I like boiled corn.
秋天，农民在地里收玉米。
In autumn, farmers harvest corn in the fields.
电视剧里的太监常说“奴才知道了”。
Eunuchs in TV dramas often say "Your servant understands".
他像奴才一样听老板的话。
He obeys the boss like a lackey.
use: Insulting today; Qing-era servants used it of themselves.

m: **Pass on** and **hand over**: to **pass on**, transmit.
ex: 请把这本书传递给后面的同学。
Please pass this book to the students behind you.
音乐可以传递感情。
Music can convey feelings.
use: For objects and for messages or feelings.

ex: 他次日早上就离开了。
He left the next morning.
飞机晚点了，我们次日才到北京。
The plane was late, so we only reached Beijing the next day.
最近生意怎么样？
How's business lately?
他在上海做服装生意。
He runs a clothing business in Shanghai.
波斯猫很漂亮。
Persian cats are beautiful.
古代中国和波斯有很多贸易往来。
Ancient China traded a lot with Persia.
这是全书的精华。
This is the best part of the whole book.
我们要学习传统文化的精华。
We should learn the best of traditional culture.
敌人占据了这座城市。
The enemy occupied the city.
这件事占据了我所有的时间。
This took up all my time.

m: **Go out** of the **door**: to **go out**, leave home.
ex: 出门记得带钥匙。
Remember your keys when you go out.
今天下大雨，我不想出门。
It's pouring today; I don't want to go out.
use: Also "be away from home": 出门在外.

ex: 他们一边走一边喊口号。
They shouted slogans as they marched.
这个口号很好记。
This slogan is easy to remember.
南非在非洲的最南边。
South Africa is at the southern tip of Africa.
他去南非看了世界杯。
He went to South Africa to watch the World Cup.
我们年初就开始准备了。
We started preparing at the start of the year.
今年年初，他换了一份新工作。
Early this year, he changed jobs.
use: Opposite 年底 "end of the year".

ex: 他父母以前在公社工作。
His parents used to work in the commune.
巴黎公社发生在一八七一年。
The Paris Commune took place in 1871.
use: Usually means 人民公社 in China.

ex: 天安门前有两根华表。
There are two marble pillars in front of Tian'anmen.
华表上刻着漂亮的龙。
Beautiful dragons are carved on the pillar.
use: Measure word 根 or 座.

ex: 医生诊断他得了感冒。
The doctor diagnosed him with a cold.
这个诊断结果让大家放心了。
The diagnosis put everyone's mind at ease.
这是我的名片。
This is my business card.
见面的时候，他们互相交换了名片。
When they met, they exchanged business cards.
use: Measure word 张. Also figurative: 城市名片 "city's calling card".

ex: 感谢你的帮助。
Thank you for your help.
我要感谢所有支持我的人。
I want to thank everyone who supported me.
墙上贴着一条标语。
There's a slogan on the wall.
学校里到处是欢迎新生的标语。
The school is full of banners welcoming new students.
use: Measure word 条. Written, unlike 口号.

ex: 她善于交朋友。
She's good at making friends.
他很善于表达自己的想法。
He's very good at expressing his ideas.
use: Followed by a verb; close to 擅长.

ex: 他必定会来的。
He'll definitely come.
只要努力，你必定会成功。
As long as you work hard, you're bound to succeed.
这个景区周末人很多。
This scenic area is crowded at weekends.
进景区要买门票。
You need a ticket to enter the scenic area.
use: Bigger than 景点 "a single sight".

ex: 病人已经脱离了危险。
The patient is out of danger.
他很早就脱离了父母，自己生活。
He left his parents early to live on his own.
你来自何处？
Where do you come from?
我不知道他现在身在何处。
I don't know where he is now.

m: An **old** **person** of the family: a polite word for an **elderly person**.
ex: 老人家，您慢点走。
Take it slowly, sir.
他老人家今年九十岁了。
The old gentleman is ninety this year.

m: The **chief** of a **group**: a **regiment commander**, head of a delegation.
ex: 他是代表团的团长。
He's the head of the delegation.
团长带着士兵们过了河。
The regiment commander led the soldiers across the river.
这是恐龙的化石。
This is a dinosaur fossil.
科学家在这里发现了很多化石。
Scientists found many fossils here.
写论文要看很多文献。
Writing a thesis means reading a lot of literature.
这些历史文献非常珍贵。
These historical documents are very valuable.

m: An **older brother** under the same **teacher**: a **senior fellow student**.
ex: 师兄帮了我很多。
My senior classmate helped me a lot.
他是我在大学的师兄。
He was my senior at university.
use: Female: 师姐; junior: 师弟, 师妹.

ex: 请输入你的密码。
Please enter your password.
这些水果是从国外输入的。
These fruits were imported from abroad.
请在指定地点停车。
Please park in the designated area.
老师指定他当班长。
The teacher appointed him class monitor.
use: 指定 + noun: 指定地点, 指定时间.

ex: 两国领导人举行了会谈。
The leaders of the two countries held talks.
会谈进行了三个小时。
The talks went on for three hours.
沿着这条路一直走。
Go straight along this road.
我们沿着河边散步。
We strolled along the river.
这件事引发了很多讨论。
This sparked a lot of discussion.
大雨引发了洪水。
The heavy rain caused flooding.
宇宙是无限的。
The universe is infinite.
孩子们有无限的想象力。
Children have boundless imagination.
他是公司的法律顾问。
He's the company's legal adviser.
我们请了一位专家做顾问。
We hired an expert as a consultant.

m: **Open** **seal**: **Kaifeng**, an old capital in Henan; also to open a package.
ex: 开封是宋朝的首都。
Kaifeng was the capital of the Song dynasty.
这瓶药开封以后要放在冰箱里。
After this bottle of medicine is opened, keep it in the fridge.
社会各界都很关心这件事。
All sectors of society are concerned about this.
各界人士来参加了开幕式。
People from all walks of life came to the opening ceremony.
他丧失了信心。
He lost confidence.
这次事故让他丧失了工作能力。
The accident left him unable to work.
use: Formal; for abstract things: 能力, 信心, 机会.

ex: 我的皮肤很敏感。
My skin is very sensitive.
这是一个敏感的话题，别提了。
It's a sensitive topic; don't bring it up.
合同从签字那天起生效。
The contract takes effect from the day it's signed.
新规定下个月一号生效。
The new rules take effect on the 1st of next month.
他常常帮助穷人。
He often helps the poor.
那时候很多穷人吃不饱饭。
In those days many poor people didn't have enough to eat.
这只是一个草案，还要修改。
This is only a draft; it needs revising.
大会讨论了新法律的草案。
The congress discussed the draft of the new law.
这里的鱼很新鲜。
The fish here is very fresh.
第一次出国，一切都很新鲜。
Going abroad for the first time, everything felt new.
他拿到了毕业证书。
He got his graduation certificate.
通过考试以后可以得到一张证书。
After passing the exam you get a certificate.
use: Measure word 张 or 本.

ex: 他抬起头看着我。
He raised his head and looked at me.
我们两个人一起把桌子抬起来。
The two of us lifted the table together.
他是一名游泳运动员。
He's a swimmer.
运动员们每天都要训练很长时间。
Athletes train for long hours every day.
use: Measure word 名 or 位.
